title: Quantitative decomposition and approximation for quasi-local operators
summary: We develop a quantitative approach to quasi-local operators with bounded block-rank. Our main results are a quantitative decomposition for quasi-local operators into block-rank-one pieces and a quantitative finite-propagation approximation in the block-rank-one case, leading to a quantitative proof of the bounded block-rank rigidity result for Roe and quasi-local algebras.
